title: Historical guesser-inspired journey through time
author: iKitch_
selftext:
Hi all, I am building a guesser-inspired history game (Then & There, www.thenandthere.co.uk) and would love your feedback! The idea is super simple and familiar guess a place and our location and see your score. AI did an amazing job at generating the 360 panorama’s and each scene is manually curated for accuracy.

I’m trying to make it feel like a proper historical deduction game where people cannot just look back into what history looked like, but also learn about major events. I have included historical notes and clues after each scene to help with this.

comments.author: ninjasaid13
comments.body: some of them look more like an illustration than a google map street view.

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: Yep you’re totally right. I need to nail down what style it is I really like. Thank you for giving it a go and commenting I really appreciate it

comments.author: Stadics3
comments.body:
These seem to be multiplying quite rapidly. What in your mind is the kick-ass feature that differentiates you? From first glimpse it may be your very thorough result page. It's much closer to a learning/study tool than others I have seen. Might be worth doubling down on that.  
  
Small note in terms of the visualisation, I suggest taking a look at [https://wen-ware.com/](https://wen-ware.com/), I think their panorama looks much more appealing and reminiscent of Google Streetview. Might be a FoV thing?

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body:
Hey thank you for your comment. Yes my idea is making a game where you don’t just explore the past but also learn about it. 

Another differentiator is some others I’ve seen unfortunately are not historically curated. I am aiming for accuracy > AI’s first pass of a historical event (often wrong armour types, wrong flags/heraldry, wrong weapons etc) 

So yes - education/accuracy, entertainment, leaderboards, and hopefully a community of engaged folk. 

I also have  a daily challenge system with high scores so there is a bit of competition, daily streaks etc!

replies.author: Woitee
replies.body: Oh, I like this approach. However, isn't that just an untenable amount of work from your side? If someone has to curate every single view?

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: It has taken me ages. But I enjoy it and I want to create something good.

replies.author: Woitee
replies.body: How many views are you aiming for? Will you create a curated img for every day of the year or something?

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: No it is all just major historical events

comments.author: Tipitak
comments.body: One of the pleasure of geoguessr is to observe details along the area. Do you plan to allow to stray on the borders of events?

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: I would love to do that, but technologically it’s a bit challenging (it’d require hjndred of historically curated photos per scene) and also introduce some inaccuracies when moving between streets for example. This is only something I’ve been building in my evenings, so maybe…

comments.author: EnumeratedArray
comments.body: The sub has about 10 of these every day now

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: Hopefully that isn’t true as I don’t want that much competition. But I welcome people doing similar ideas. It’s a fun concept and it’s good to learn history so I don’t mind. I just want to be the best and make something decent!

comments.author: WorkOwn
comments.body: cool, but there are spoilers in "share the results"

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: Hmmm very true….. maybe I should remove this. Thanks for the spot!

comments.author: cloud-eating-monk
comments.body:
this is really fun. great work. ive played four rounds already

some feedback:
- it tells me how many years off i was, but not what year i guessed anywhere. i do want to know which year i guessed
- would like it to be more photographic and for the 360 FOV to be refined
- i want more levels!! in non-Western areas would be great
- when i play random, i wish it would track what ive seen already so i don’t have to repeat levels — or at least at some sort of option

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: Thank you for the lovely comment! I will incorporate most of this feedback tonight and refine the rest over time :)

comments.author: piggledy
comments.body: There is a similar one called [timeguessr.com](http://timeguessr.com) but with real photos

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: Thanks for showing me, I will work to incorporate the best features. I note they defo won’t have photos before photos were a thing though…. IE most of history tbf.

comments.author: ffaiithh
comments.body: Tried it, had a lot of fun, for people who loves history it's really great opportunity to spend time

replies.author: iKitch_
replies.body: Thank you so much!! Means a lot to me, hope you keep playing as I make improvements daily
